fields.label: Quick Setup — Base Colors
fields.description: Set these 3 colors and click Apply Theme — all brand, text and background shades below will be auto-generated. You can still override them individually.

fields.label: Primary / Brand Color
fields.description: Your brand accent color. Auto-derives: Primary, Hover (dark), Hover (light), Faint

fields.label: Main Text Color
fields.description: Used for headings and body text. Auto-derives: Primary Text, Text Hover

fields.label: Page Background Color
fields.description: Base page background. Auto-derives: Light BG, Warm BG, Secondary BG

fields.label: Button Colors
fields.description: Colors for all call-to-action buttons across the webshop (Add to Cart, Contact, Apply, etc.)

fields.label: Button Background
fields.description: Fill color of buttons in their default state

fields.label: Button Text
fields.description: Label/icon color inside buttons

fields.label: Button Hover Background
fields.description: Fill color when hovering over a button

fields.label: Button Hover Text
fields.description: Label color when hovering over a button

fields.label: Brand Colors (Advanced)
fields.description: Auto-filled from Primary / Brand Color above. Override manually if needed.

fields.label: Primary Color
fields.description: Main accent — badges, borders, icon fills

fields.label: Primary Dark (Hover)
fields.description: Slightly darker shade for pressed/active states

fields.label: Primary Light (Hover)
fields.description: Slightly lighter shade for hover tints and underlines

fields.label: Primary Faint (Background Tint)
fields.description: Very light primary tint — used in section backgrounds, pills, tags

fields.label: Text Colors (Advanced)
fields.description: Auto-filled from Main Text Color above.

fields.label: Primary Text
fields.description: Main dark text — headings, prices, product titles

fields.label: Text Hover / Muted
fields.description: Slightly lighter — subtitles, hover text, secondary labels

fields.label: Background Colors (Advanced)
fields.description: Auto-filled from Page Background Color above.

fields.label: Light Background
fields.description: Cream/off-white — alternating section backgrounds

fields.label: Warm Background
fields.description: Warm cream — used in product grids, cards backgrounds

fields.label: Secondary Background
fields.description: Light gray — footer, filter panels, input backgrounds

fields.label: Branding Assets
fields.description: Logos and section backgrounds. All images marked auto-generated are re-created automatically every time you Apply Theme.

fields.label: Navbar Logo
fields.description: Shown in the top navigation bar — auto-generated from theme colors on Apply

fields.label: Footer Logo
fields.description: White/inverted version shown in the dark footer — auto-generated on Apply

fields.label: "What Makes Us Different" Background
fields.description: Decorative background for the Why Us section — auto-generated SVG on Apply

fields.label: Hero Carousel Images
fields.description: Up to 3 banner images shown in the home page carousel slider. Recommended size: 1280×480 px.

fields.label: Custom Images
fields.description: Additional image assets used by the webshop pages (product banners, section backgrounds, etc.)
